analysis_scope: Response-style analysis uses only prepared training responses. Evaluation summaries read saved run outputs; no training, ablation, or attribution method is performed.
tokenizer: train.tokenize: lowercased Unicode words and punctuation, regex \w+|[^\w\s]
punctuation_definition: Number and percentage of training responses containing at least one literal ASCII colon (:) or semicolon (;); a response may count in both categories.
quantile_method: numpy.percentile default method='linear'; standard deviation uses ddof=1.

figure_notes.confusion_matrices: Held-out test set. Combined means prompt + response. Each row totals 450; annotations are counts and color is within-row percentage. Class abbreviations: Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro.
figure_notes.response_lengths: Training set only; n=2100 per model. Boxes show Q1-Q3, line is median, diamond is mean, whiskers extend to observations within 1.5 IQR, dots are observations beyond whiskers. Tokens use train.tokenize before truncation.
figure_notes.validation_curves: Saved validation macro F1 for each completed epoch. Outlined circles mark the checkpoint selected by the original run; line endpoints reflect early stopping or the ten-epoch limit.
